premises.text: There is a market for local content in Tanzania.
premises.evidence_span: we are building a media streaming platform for mostly local content

premises.text: Tango TV has a mobile app for streaming content.
premises.evidence_span: You can stream Tango TV on your mobile phone.

premises.text: Tango TV seeks investment to enhance its platform and content acquisition.
premises.evidence_span: we are here seeking $500,000 in exchange for e-quedit at a pre-money valuation of over $2 million

premises.text: Tango TV has established relationships with content creators in Tanzania.
premises.evidence_span: we already have a good relationship with content creators in Tanzania

premises.text: The business model includes a royalty-based payment system for content creators.
premises.evidence_span: when a user pays for a movie, that's when the content creator says, hey, my movie was watched 10 times, so you should pay me this much money

value.text: Local content is accessible through a streaming platform.
value.evidence_span: local movies, local TV shows, even local music videos

notes: Investment ask and negotiation details are excluded as they do not represent premises.
